title: Fingerprint stability
description: client.fingerprints.stability: for each fingerprint surface, how many main-thread reads were taken, how many distinct values came back, whether the Web Worker and iframe reads matched, and whether a fixed control render came back altered. Counts and booleans only, never the values read. The Worker re-derives classification from these numbers.

distinct.description: Distinct values among the main-thread reads. 0 when every read failed or came back empty.

workerMatch.description: Whether a Web Worker read matched the main thread. null when the surface has no worker read or the worker could not read it.

iframeMatch.description: Whether a same-origin iframe read matched the main thread. null when the iframe could not read it.

controlAltered.description: Whether a fixed control render (solid-colour canvas, constant audio buffer) came back different from the known result. null for surfaces without a control.
